channel.title: Said & Checked: Nebraska — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day from or about Nebraska, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Nebraska, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 2 unsupported, 4 unsettled (Deb Fischer)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported and Unsettled

  • Deb Fischer, U.S. Senator: “the managers' package alone included amendments from Members on both sides of the aisle--38 from Republicans, 38 from Democrats--and 10 that were crafted on a bipartisan basis.” Unsupported. No published count of the managers' package amendments by party was found; the search covered the warehouse bill records and web searches, and no committee description of the package was located.
  • Deb Fischer, U.S. Senator: “our portion of this year's NDAA addressed 184 requests from Senators on both sides of the aisle.” Unsupported. No committee or subcommittee document stating 184 Senator requests was found; the search covered the warehouse and web searches.
  • Deb Fischer, U.S. Senator: “for the first time in history, the United States faces two peer nuclear adversaries at once.” Unsettled. The 2023 congressional Strategic Posture Commission report says the U.S. will face two nuclear peer adversaries for the first time in 2027-2035 and is on the cusp of it, calling Russia a peer and China advancing toward peer status, a future rather than present finding.

22 statements by 2 officeholders. 11 checked: 5 supported, 4 unsettled, 2 unsupported · 8 not yet checked · 3 not checkable.
